source.notes: ISC Class XI school half-yearly examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Half-yearly Examination - 2016-2017', 'PHYSICS', 'Std. : XI', 'Time : 3 Hrs. 15 min', 'F. M. : 80'; examYear 2017 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 195 = 3 h 15 min as printed. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Part I: Q1 (A) five 1-mark MCQs, Q1 B seven 1-mark short answers, Q1 C four 2-mark answers; Part II: Q2-Q18. Q3, Q11, Q15, Q16, Q17 and Q18 have internal OR choices (alternatives labelled (a)/(b) by the editor). Q9 and Q13 have no printed mark (taken from the neighbouring questions, see their issues). The marks (one alternative per OR choice) add up to 69, not the printed F.M. 80, so some marks on the paper appear inconsistent. Vector arrows, powers, subscripts and fractions were rebuilt from the page images as Unicode/inline text. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
